card.name: Inside long ALL-CAPS medical words
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of long words written in all capitals, such as ELECTROLYTES, EPILEPTICUS, SULFATE and ACTIVITIES, mostly in uppercase warning text. The next piece is usually a T or similar.

modes.label: Capitalized medical terms
modes.description: Partway through an uppercase drug or medical term in label warnings.

modes.label: Other capitalized words
modes.description: Partway through other uppercase words, including a name or heading.
modes.example: THEODORE ROOSE<<VEL>>T'S accession to the presidency

card.writes: It favors a following T-starting piece and discourages R-starting pieces, which fits finishing the middle of an uppercase word.
card.plain: It fires inside long medical words typed in all capitals, like ELECTROLYTES, before the word's ending.
